title: History timeline: camera travels along the axis (Canvas)
description: A timeline/history explainer: a kicker and title rise in and slide into the header while the axis draws itself; the camera then glides along the axis from event to event as year ticks and a large ghost year counter roll by; at each event a pin drops onto the axis with a ripple, a stem grows and a card lands with the date, a label and an optional note; the travelled axis turns to the accent colour and a progress track fills. The camera finally zooms out to the whole axis, every pin lights with its date and a summary line lands. Dates are drawn exactly as given; ticks and the counter use their years when every date contains one.

title.default: Five moments that made the web
title.description: What the timeline is about; becomes the header after the intro

kicker.description: Small tracked label above the title (empty for none)

dates.description: Event dates in chronological order, drawn exactly as given: a string ('1969', 'July 1969', 'c. 3000 BCE') or a whole year as a number (negative numbers are shown as BC)

labels.description: What happened at each date (same order as dates), a short headline each

default: Two computers, one crash, the letters L and O
Every network can now talk to every other
A memo his boss called vague but exciting
The first browser most people ever used
Blogs, wikis and comments take over
notes.description: Optional one-line detail under each label (same order; empty string for none)

summary.default: Fifty years from two letters to billions of pages
summary.description: Closing line shown over the zoomed-out timeline (empty for none)

spacing.description: even: one camera move per event; proportional: positions follow the years (with a minimum gap) when every date has one

palette.description: Ground, ink, accent (pins, travelled axis, dates), paper (card tint) and muted (ticks, notes)

grid.description: Opacity of the far parallax rules

notes: Needs `pip install playwright` and `playwright install chromium-headless-shell`.
Uses the system's Inter (fonts-inter) when installed, else Helvetica Neue/Arial.

Beats: intro = clamp(0.12 D, 1.6, 2.4); outro = clamp(0.18 D, 2.4, 3.6); beat = (D - intro - outro) / N; travel = min(1.0, 0.3 beat); the camera moves into event k from intro + k beat - travel and the card lands at intro + k beat (pin 0.1 s earlier); the zoom-out starts at D - outro and the summary lands 0.6 s later.
Render cost measured side by side with scene.steps under identical load: within 5% of it at 1080x1920; vg.grain is about 12% of the total.
